Description: Identified a Private Key, which may compromise cryptographic security and sensitive data encryption.
Author: SPrime01
Message:
feat(ledger): complete M0b — witness receipts, global checkpoints, redaction, key rotation, crash recovery

Add WitnessReceipt struct with independent witness verification: receipts
are signed over canonical bytes (excluding receipt_hash and witness_signature);
independence check rejects witness == acting_entity; fork substitution
detected via receipt hash mismatch.

Add GlobalCheckpoint and LedgerManager: creates signed global checkpoints
committing all active stream roots in deterministic order; verify checks
global_root recomputation, signature, and chain linkage.

Add redaction policy: payloads containing secret sentinels (private key
blocks, API keys, passwords) are rejected with typed ledger_integrity_error;
approved ciphertext commitments (redacted_commitment field) pass.

Add key rotation: verify_checkpoints_with_keys accepts a key_id → VerifyingKey
map; old checkpoints verify under their snapshotted key refs; removing a key
rejects checkpoints signed by it.

Add crash recovery: quarantine_incomplete_tail detects truncated JSON lines,
moves them to quarantine/, and truncates the entries file to valid records.

New conformance tests (9 additional, 16 total):
- m0_witness_receipt_detects_fork_substitution
- m0_witness_must_be_independent_from_acting_entity
- m0_global_checkpoint_covers_all_streams
- m0_global_checkpoint_chain
- m0_secret_sentinel_rejected_in_payload
- m0_private_key_block_rejected
- m0_approved_ciphertext_commitment_accepted
- m0_key_rotation_old_checkpoints_verify_under_old_key
- m0_crash_recovery_quarantines_incomplete_tail

Gate: clippy -D warnings, 58 workspace tests, P1-P4b, no-async-kernel — green.
